en-US.MVZ2 用户数据的 GitHub 云存档。: GitHub cloud saves for MVZ2 user data.
en-US.云存档只在非关卡状态同步关卡进度。关卡内会先记录改动，退出关卡后再上传。: Cloud Saves only syncs level progress outside a level. Changes made in a level are recorded and uploaded after you leave the level.
en-US.云存档：请先配置 token 和仓库: Cloud Saves: configure token and repository first
en-US.云存档：请先退出关卡再同步: Cloud Saves: leave the level before syncing
en-US.云存档：token 不能为空: Cloud Saves: token cannot be empty
en-US.云存档：游戏尚未就绪: Cloud Saves: game is not ready
en-US.云存档：token 无效或已过期: Cloud Saves: token is invalid or expired
en-US.云存档：token 已保存，但验证失败：{0}: Cloud Saves: token saved, but validation failed: {0}
en-US.云存档：已从剪贴板粘贴 {0} 个字符: Cloud Saves: pasted {0} characters from the clipboard
en-US.云存档：仓库必须是私有的: Cloud Saves: repository must be private
en-US.云存档：token 没有该仓库的写入权限: Cloud Saves: token has no write access to this repository
en-US.云存档：仓库名不能为空: Cloud Saves: repository name cannot be empty
en-US.云存档：创建仓库失败: Cloud Saves: failed to create repository
en-US.云存档：云端还没有存档: Cloud Saves: no cloud save yet
en-US.云存档：云端已有存档，请使用「从云端恢复」: Cloud Saves: cloud save exists, use Restore from cloud
en-US.云端 manifest 丢失，请先检查云端仓库: Cloud manifest is missing; check the repository
en-US.云端已有存档，本地也有存档，请选择保留哪一边: Both cloud and local saves exist; choose which to keep
en-US.本地和云端都有改动，请处理冲突: Local and cloud both changed; resolve the conflict
en-US.本地有未同步的改动，不能直接覆盖: Local has unsynced changes and cannot be overwritten
en-US.云存档：已是最新: Cloud Saves: already up to date
en-US.云存档：本地又有保存，稍后重试: Cloud Saves: local save changed again, retrying later
en-US.云存档：已上传，但本地又有修改: Cloud Saves: uploaded, but local changed again
en-US.云存档：配置已更改，本次拉取已取消: Cloud Saves: configuration changed; pull cancelled
en-US.云存档：配置已更改，本次上传未记入检查点: Cloud Saves: configuration changed; upload not recorded
en-US.云存档：已下载，退出关卡后应用: Cloud Saves: downloaded; will apply after leaving the level
en-US.云存档：已开始同步（非关卡状态才会执行）: Cloud Saves: sync started (only outside a level)
en-US.云存档：GitHub 限流，稍后重试: Cloud Saves: GitHub rate limited, try later
en-US.保存后自动上传；关卡内只记录改动，退出关卡后上传。: Upload automatically after saving. Inside a level only changes are recorded; upload happens after leaving the level.
en-US.只在非关卡状态应用云端存档。: Apply cloud saves only outside a level.
en-US.合并连续保存的等待秒数。: Seconds to wait before merging consecutive saves.
en-US.发生冲突时默认保留本地。: Keep local by default on conflict.
en-US.这会用本地存档覆盖云端，确定继续吗？: This will overwrite the cloud with local saves. Continue?
en-US.这会用云端存档覆盖本地（会先备份），确定继续吗？: This will overwrite local saves with the cloud (a backup is made first). Continue?
en-US.云存档：云端有更新，请使用「从云端恢复」: Cloud Saves: cloud has updates; use Restore from cloud
